prompt:
Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, here are the officially documented context window and output token limits for the current Claude model family. The search results did not contain information about the GPT model family, so I am noting that as unfound.

**Claude Model Family**

**Context Windows:**
The current flagship Claude models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5.5, Sonnet 5, etc.) feature a 1M-token context window, while older/smaller models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 have a 200k-token context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: Multiple current Claude models have a 1M-token context window.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Other Claude models, like Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window.

**Output Token Limits:**
For the synchronous Messages API, models with a 1M-token context window can generate up to 128k output tokens, while 200k-token models (like Haiku 4.5) can generate up to 64k output tokens. On the Message Batches API, certain models support up to 300k output tokens.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: 1M-context Claude models can output up to 128k tokens on the synchronous API.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Sonnet 4.6 support up to 300k output tokens by using the `output-300k-2026-03-24` beta header." | CLAIM: Certain Claude models support up to 300k output tokens on the Message Batches API.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview?f80ce999_sort_date=desc | QUOTE: "Context window | 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 200k tokens Max output | 128k tokens | 128k tokens | 128k tokens | 64k tokens" | CLAIM: The 200k-token context window models (like Claude Haiku 4.5) are limited to 64k output tokens.

**GPT Model Family**
